column2: Coefficient vectors for SLVQ/SLVC and tzyx<->v4 conversions; state-file bounds hardening; dynamic-menu index bounds; equals back in the EQN UI; WHO screen rework
column8: Advanced from 4697e526a (79 commits). Import-only-changed-paths: 66 of 137 changed paths were tracked; 3 new testSuite/tests files imported with them (cpxslv_cov, eqslv_cov, stkexV4), which the imported testSuiteList.txt names. .gitignore reconciled by hand (upstream's LaTeX-byproduct block only); testSuite.c 3-way merged over z47's covPlotGuard/G4b divergence; res/testPgms/testPgms.bin regenerated rather than imported. PORTS: (1) SLVQ/SLVC accept a 2-to-4-element coefficient vector in X and return every root as a row vector -- new solveCoefficientVector in the slvc owner, with solveQuadratic/solveCubic lifted out of fnSlvq/fnSlvc so both entry points reach the precision the build selects; vecCreate[] gained a 1x4 form (VECT_CR_tzyx) and a t/tdef column, shifting M_CR_zyx 9->10, and the probed bitfield mirror became a named-field struct; the stk<->mx converters are now unconditional (z47 does not model OPTION_SLV_ZETA_BETA, which is on for every build it produces). (2) State-file hardening: every count a .sav/.d47 names is bounded before it indexes kbd_usr/userMenuItems/userAlphaItems/userMenus[].menuItem/the statistical sums; every section breaks on an end-of-file read; refused allocations are checked in initUserKeyArgument/setUserKeyArgument/createMenu/the EQUATIONS section; freeListAlloc checks its region bound before the store; a zero-block PROGRAMS section is neutralised and resizeProgramMemory floors at one block; the EQUATIONS loop index widened past int16; the save side writes only formulae that have text; readToken/readComplexToken take a length and drain the overlong token; standardiseComplex refuses an element that cannot fit. (3) Dynamic-menu bounds: currentDynamicSoftmenu() exported and taken by fnSolveVar/fnIntVar/processKeyAction/dynmenuGetLabelWithDup, and _dynmenuConstructMVarsFromPgm bounds its label -- the newly imported covMvarPageNoProgram case SEGV'd without it. (4) Equals back in the EQN UI, Draw plots an equation's left hand side (eqnDrawLhsOnly), a complex lhs skips fnToReal, Calc f' auto-assigns the formula's sole variable or refuses. (5) A reserved variable keeps its declared type (reallocateRegister refuses, setRegisterDataType's reserved branch no longer retypes an unrelated named variable, fnStoreConfig checks the destination). (6) WHO owns the screen (new whoStr2 roll, blank MNU_SHOW menu, MNU_SHOW guards in the menu clears, EXIT dismisses only the screen); a program-drawn screen survives SNAP (screenHoldsDrawnPixels). (7) MAX_ENGINE_NESTING_DEPTH 2->1 on the DM42 and the 1071-digit trig working reals moved off the frame. Removed with upstream: fnEuclideanNorm, isValidTime, ULFL/ULGL, pointerOfFlashPgmLibrary/sizeOfFlashPgmLibrary, matEditMode. DELIBERATELY NOT PORTED: the STACK_WATERMARK debug tool (memory.c/items.c/c47.c/lblGtoXeq.c hooks) -- defines.h defines then immediately #undefs it on every target, verified by reading defines.h rather than assumed. OPEN, NOT PORTED: the same stack->heap move for solver/solve.c (37 sites) and solver/graph.c (~21) -- a frame-size refactor with no host-visible behaviour change, but it is the DM42 stack headroom the lowered nesting cap was paired with; the firmware lanes must be re-checked before relying on that cap. testSuite 12835/12835, 0 failed (baseline before the import: 12763/12763).
